ios.label: Pixy scores last night from how long you slept, your usual bedtime, and wake-ups, then picks the sleep quality. Check-ins skip the sleep step. Edit an entry to change its sleep quality. Pixy only reads sleep data. It stays on this iPhone.
Weekly, monthly, and yearly recaps arrive on the last day of each week, month, and year, at your reminder time.
